entities.name: Marija Šestić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marija Šestić is a Bosnian Serb singer and musician. She is most known for representing Bosnia and Herzegovina in the Eurovision Song Contest 2007 in Helsinki, Finland. Performing the song "Rijeka bez imena", Šestić collected a total of 106 points, placing eleventh out of twenty-four entries.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marija Šestić is a Bosnian Serb singer and musician. She is most known for representing Bosnia and Herzegovina in the Eurovision Song Contest 2007 in Helsinki, Finland. Performing the song "Rijeka bez imena", Šestić collected a total of 106 points, placing eleventh out of twenty-four entries.
